events.info: To ensure an expedited entry experience on the Rose Quarter campus we would suggest travelling without a bag whenever possible. Guests are permitted bags up to 10× 6× 2 in size and will require a secondary screening for further inspection in a designated bag line. Please anticipate additional wait times if bringing a bag. Medical and childcare exceptions are permitted and will be screened via x-ray at designated locations, but cannot exceed 14x14 x 6. Bag check will be available for a fee; however, checking prohibited items will be denied.

boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Apple Pay, Visa, AMX, MC and Discover. We do not accept cash.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Tickets held at will call can be picked up on the day of the performance at the box office beginning 2 hours prior to the event. The customer must present valid form of picture identification and the credit card used for purchase.

venues.parkingDetail: On-site parking at the Garden Garage, the East/West Broadway Garages, and at all times for restaurant and retail parking at the One Center Court Garage. Parking may be purchased in advance at all Ticketmaster Ticket Center locations or by Charge-By-Phone: 800-745-3000.
